reporting_amendments.reason: Replace an unconditional competitive conclusion with the measured 64-neuron accuracy gap and distinguish the validation-selected 32-neuron ablation.
reporting_amendments.original_conclusion: Conclusion: competitive but not superior in this CPU software prototype. No measured energy advantage or real-world robustness is established.
reporting_amendments.amended_conclusion: Conclusion: The separately seeded 64-neuron reference has mean test macro-F1 0.8500 versus 0.9032 for the matched logistic baseline, a 5.32-percentage-point gap that misses the provisional five-point criterion. The predefined 32-neuron architecture ablation has macro-F1 0.8619 and a 4.12-point gap, meeting the criterion; selection used validation macro-F1 only. Neither SNN outperforms the conventional baselines. The 64-neuron reference remains the baseline. No measured energy advantage or real-world robustness is established.
reporting_amendments.scope: Reporting-only amendment after the original evidence-generation run. The original git_commit and source_sha256 describe that evaluated run and remain unchanged. Checkpoints, training histories, confusion matrices and numerical metric artifacts are unchanged.
reporting_amendments.byte_changes: Report text uses LF line endings. The original report used CRLF. Conclusion text and the reporting note are the only content changes.
